role: Line-of-sight cache for the targeting tasks: canSee raytraces eye to eye once per entity per cache generation and remembers the answer until clearSensingCache.

members.name: entityObj
members.note: folded: the cache is the senses member of struct living

members.name: seenEntities
members.note: senses.seen[64] with nseen, a fixed array instead of the ArrayList (capacity 64 vs Java's unbounded list)

members.name: canSee
members.note: cache hit, otherwise the eye-to-eye raytrace (Java calls EntityLiving.canEntityBeSeen; native calls raytrace_trace directly) and the result cached

notes: The engine clears the cache where EntityLiving.onUpdate clears it; the 64-entry cap is a fixed-capacity stand-in for the lists and cannot overflow silently beyond 64 distinct queried entities per generation.
